queueSingleFileHint: Choose one main version per mod.
queueAdditionalHint: Independent selection: choose multiple files without replacing the main version. Read the author’s notes; not all files are compatible with each other.
browserPreview: Integrated browser preview. The Nexus website, login and download capture run in the native application.
internalNexusLogin: Sign in to Nexus · internal browser
internalBrowserHint: Prototype: sign in to Nexus in the internal browser using the same account connected to the launcher. If the page does not work, use the external browser.
browserConfirmation: Waiting for download confirmation in the browser
browserConfirmationHint: In the Nexus window, confirm Mod Manager Download. PeliGames will capture the request and show progress here. In the external browser, allow PeliGames to open.
queueAuthorize: Confirm Mod Manager Download in the browser. Once the launcher captures the download, the queue opens the next page. Files continue downloading in the background.
queueAlreadyInstalled: Already available in the game or library — will not download again
queueLimit: Limit of 16 mods per selection. Check remaining requirements on the website.
waitPreviousAction: Please wait: another Nexus action is still running.
noManagerDownload: This mod does not offer a mod manager download (Vortex button) on Nexus. PeliGames installs only mods with that support; follow the author's manual installation for this one.
lootHint: Once the LOOT masterlist is downloaded, plugins are sorted by LOOT on every deployment. If LOOT fails, the current order is kept and the reason is logged.
bainHint: Choose the numbered packages. They are installed into Data in numeric order; a later package replaces files of an earlier one. wizard.txt scripts are not run.
fomodHint: Choose the package options. Only selected files will be installed; your choices are retained when re-enabling the mod.
removeSelectedPrompt: Remove the selected mods from the profile and delete their imported archives?
catalogNotMatched: Nexus Mods: no game with confirmed Vortex support found for this name. Check the title and refresh the library.
prefixAdditionHint: Existing Wine/Proton prefix (also accepts compatdata or pfx). Leave empty for automatic detection.
addRequired: Confirm the name and choose the game folder and executable to add it.
coverMissing: No cover found. You can choose an image later.
deployCopyHint: Copies profile files to the game.
deploySymlinkHint: Links game files to the profile.
deployHardlinkHint: Shares files on the same filesystem.
deployVfsHint: Virtual view when launching with mods. Requires FUSE and bubblewrap.
allModsHint: All available mods for this game, without a category filter. Use See more to load the next results.
gameUnidentified: No installation rule identified. You can associate the catalog manually.
isolatedProfile: Mods will be applied in an isolated Valheim profile.
autoAssociationHint: We search Nexus using the saved game name. Select the matching game; the installation folder stays the same.
noMatchingGame: No games found. Adjust the search name.
dependencyQueued: Dependency queued. The launcher will track download and installation. FOMOD options require confirmation in the Mods tab.
dependencyAuthorize: Confirm Mod Manager Download on Nexus. The launcher will track download and installation; confirm FOMOD options in the Mods tab.
dependencyOtherGame: This requirement belongs to another game. Open its page to check installation instructions.
dependencyZipHint: Installation supports ZIP, 7z and RAR. FOMOD choices are configured in the Mods tab. Read the description and choose the version compatible with your game.
slowDownloadWatch: You can also use Slow download in an external browser: once the file finishes in the Downloads folder, its content is verified (MD5) and it is imported automatically. The original file is kept.
dependencyInstallFailed: Check the error below. If the archive was already imported, it remains available in the Mods tab.
dependencyCycle: Circular dependencies. Check requirements before installing.
modUsageHint: For installation instructions and usage guidance, open the mod page using the button below.
requirementsUnavailable: This mod has no registered requirements or source page.
requirementsNone: No requirements declared by the author on Nexus.
requirementsUnknown: Could not retrieve all requirements. Check the mod page before installing.
requirementsHint: Read the author's notes: some items are optional or depend on the chosen version. Status includes registered mods and recognized files in the game folder. Detected files do not guarantee compatibility with the required version.
nxmRegistered: PeliGames is set to receive nxm:// links. Use Mod Manager Download on the website.
nxmHint: Enable Nexus links and use Mod Manager Download on the website. The archive will be downloaded and imported for the matching game.
nxmNeedsInstall: Install PeliGames on the system (Install button on the welcome screen or in Settings → Tools) to use it for Nexus links.
chooseDownloadGame: Choose the installation that will receive this mod:
addDownloadGame: Add this game to the Nexus library and associate its page in Catalog.
downloadImported: Download imported. Check requirements and click Install in the Mods tab.
associationWarning: If the catalog is incorrect or empty, select the correct title using ‘Associate game’.
associationHint: Choose the matching Nexus game to browse mods.
feedHint: Search by name across this game’s entire Nexus catalog.
invalidModReference: Enter an ID or a Nexus URL for the associated game.
browserDownloadHint: Use Mod Manager Download on the website to send the archive to PeliGames. For manual downloads, use Import downloaded archive. Check requirements before installing.
downloadOpened: File page opened. Use Mod Manager Download to download through PeliGames, or import a manual download.
archiveImported: Archive imported. Use the Mods tab to install it.
accountLoadError: Could not check the saved account. Check your connection and keyring. You can reconnect or remove the saved credentials.
accountOperationError: Could not complete the Nexus connection.
downloadAccountHint: Browse mods in the Catalog tab. Free accounts authorize downloads through the website; Premium accounts can download directly through the launcher.
reportHint: Review the report and send the file in the Discord channel.
reportSendHint: Review the report and send it straight to the Discord forum, or save the file and send it in the channel.
reportDiscordLabel: Your Discord name (optional, so we can reply)
reportPublicNotice: The report will be public in the Discord forum. Private data is filtered; review the text. Your Discord name, if provided, will be published for contact.
reportSent: Report posted in the Discord forum. Thank you!
title: Nexus Mods
name: Name
translationHint: English → Brazilian Portuguese · Online translation via MyMemory
installFromCatalog: Install mods from the Nexus catalog
emptyHint: Add a game to install local mods without an account. Connecting to Nexus Mods is optional and enables the online catalog.
emptyModsHint: Browse the Nexus catalog or install a downloaded archive.
batchHint: Select mods to enable, disable or remove them together.
localHint: Native Valheim: import and install BepInExPack_Valheim, dependencies and ZIP mods. The profile is separate from the game.
planOverrides: This mod replaces files of installed mods
planOverridesHint: Mods lower in the list take priority. Use the arrows in the mod list to change the winner; disabling the mod restores the other mod's files.
collectionHint: Paste the collection page link from Nexus (or open an nxm:// collection link). Mods join the download queue and are installed with the collection's FOMOD choices when they match the installer.
collectionManifestError: Collection instructions unavailable; mods will be imported and FOMOD options must be confirmed
collectionLimits: When two collection mods share a file, the later one in the collection order wins. The collection's ordering rules (modRules) and patches are not applied.
manualRootHint: Choose the archive folder that is the mod's root and where it should be installed. The game's rules still apply: destinations outside the module, original files and refused formats are not deployed.
manualRootAutomaticHint: Applies the module's routes starting from the chosen folder.
moduleDependency: Loader required by this game’s rules.
isolatedModule: Isolated BepInEx profile in Mod/Nexus/games, inside PeliGames settings.
managerRequired: These packages are prepared for Frosty/DAI Mod Manager. Open the manager, select the mods and apply/merge before starting the game.
moduleHint: ZIP, 7z and RAR files are installed at the destinations defined by the game module. External files are preserved.
moduleMissing: No module recognized for this installation.
modLoadingHint: Check the records’ date. Not every mod reports its loading in the log.
noLogs: No logs available for this session.
palworldHint: Palworld via Proton: install UE4SS and ZIP mods (.pak and Lua). Managed files are deployed into the game; external files are preserved.
unsupported: No installation module has been recognized for this game yet. You can browse the catalog and import archives.
removePrompt: Remove this mod from the profile and delete its imported archive?
accountHint: Authorization opens in your default browser. Tokens follow the selected session mode; PeliGames never receives your password.
sourceHint: Select an existing game. This only creates an association in this library.
noGames: No games available. Scan the library or add one manually.
saved: Associations and archives are stored in .config/PeliGames/components/Mods/Nexus.
pathHint: The game folder may differ from the Proton prefix.
loadOrderHint: Order of the .pak mods in the Mods folder inside modsettings.lsx (Public profile), like the Vortex load order page. New mods go to the end. Packages without meta.lsx (replacers) stay on top and are always loaded.
loadOrderEmpty: No .pak in the Mods folder. Install and enable mods to arrange them here.
loadOrderAutoExportHint: On: every order change and deployment updates the game's modsettings.lsx. Off: the game gets the order only when you click Export to game.
loadOrderModFixer: For this game version, Vortex recommends Baldur's Gate 3 Mod Fixer: most mods need it.
replacerTitle: This mod looks like a replacer
replacerHint: It replaces files shipped with the game. A replacer includes a copy of game data from a specific game version and may break as soon as the game gets updated; even if it doesn't break, it may revert bug fixes made by the developers. Keep this mod updated and remove it when it no longer matches the game version.
replacerBackup: PeliGames keeps a copy of each original and puts it back when the mod is disabled or removed. If the game updates one of these files, the new version becomes the kept original.
checkUnwanted: file shipped with some editions of the game that often breaks mods (translation plugin). The Vortex checks extension recommends removing it; here it is kept and can be put back.
checkSetAside: set aside; the copy is kept in the game's PeliGames folder.
checkLargeAddress: without the 4GB patch: the game uses only 2 GB of memory and often crashes with many mods. Install and run FNV 4GB Patcher.
checkLegacyExtender: old script extender version; current mods require xNVSE.
bsaRedirectionHint: Vortex Archive Invalidation option: creates an empty BSA listed first in the game INI, so loose mod textures and meshes take priority over the game archives. Changing it deploys the profile again.
pluginsHint: Plugins of the Data folder in the order the game loads them, like the Vortex plugins page. Untick to disable; the game's own plugins stay active. Click a name for its masters and LOOT messages.
pluginsAutosortHint: On: LOOT reorders on every change and deployment. Off: the order is yours, with the up and down buttons.
pluginsNoMasterlist: Download the LOOT masterlist in the game settings to sort and see LOOT messages.
pluginsEmpty: No plugins in the Data folder.
checkMissingExtender: not found: the script extender is not installed.
checkMissingExtenderHint: Choose the file built for your game version and store:
extenderErrorsHint: Last time the game ran, these script extender plugins did not load. Usually the mod does not match the installed extender version: look for an update on the mod page or disable it.
profilesHint: Each profile keeps which mods are enabled, their order and the game choices (plugins, load order, BSA redirection), like Vortex profiles. Downloaded archives and mod installations are shared. Switching deploys the profile's mods.
profileRemovePrompt: Click the bin again to delete the profile. Mods stay installed.
savesHint: Game saves with character, location and the plugins each one uses, like the Vortex save games page.
savesOwn: This profile has its own saves.
savesTransfer: Transfer saves to the current profile
checkMissingLoader: not installed. The Vortex extension downloads it by itself:
archiveOrderHint: Order of [Archive] sResourceArchive2List in Fallout76Custom.ini, like the Vortex extension “BA2 Archive Load Order”. Archives further down override those above. The order is saved in the profile and reapplied on every deployment; new mod archives go to the start.
archiveOrderEmpty: No BA2 archive in the list. Install and enable mods with .ba2 files.
checkMissingDownload: not installed. The Vortex extension downloads it from GitHub:
checkMissingNexusDownload: not installed. The Vortex extension downloads it from the Nexus page:
